notes.title: 1.1.3 builds are live
notes.content:
Hey all, we have just published builds 1.1.3:

- 
 There's an Undo button! You'll be able to undo your last move, provided it wasn't a move that resulted in a random outcome (example: hitting the grow button, or matching a pattern.)
 The game will now save your board progress if you exit.
 There is now  a daily mosaic that's unlocked at the end of the first path.
 We also added an option to "end the current garden" if you'd like to harvest the gems you've earned so far and move on from the current game.


Thanks for your patience, and please let us know what you think!

notes.title: 1.0.1 builds are live
notes.content:
Hey Evergardeners, we've just published a new build:
 
- Fixed some occasional crash bugs related to using some powerups
- Optimized the game a bit to run smoother, and also added a quality slider to the settings screen
- Fixed some achievement bugs where they weren't unlocking
- Fixed a score exploit

We'll have a big update in a week or two as well! As always, feel free to give us feedback on what you'd like to see, or join our discord chat:
https://discord.gg/flippfly
